gates.G1: CAGR >= K, or Calmar >= 1.1 x K with CAGR >= K - 0.5 pp (base and calibrated)
gates.G2: max DD <= K + 1.0 pp (base and calibrated)
gates.G4: CAGR above K in >= 2 of 3 sub-periods
gates.G5: block-20 pre-tax bootstrap median (arm - K) >= 0 (base and calibrated)
gates.G7: six OOS windows: median dCAGR >= 0; >= 5/6 with dCAGR >= -0.5 pp and dDD <= +3 pp; dDD never > +8 pp
gates.G8: pooled OOS bootstrap (M1-M5, 2,000 paths each): median dCAGR >= 0
gates.AT: after tax at $100k: arm - K >= 0 in all three windows
gates.BOOT: clean bootstrap B1/B2 at $100k: median d >= 0 and share > 0 >= 55 %
gates.select: an arm qualifies only if every gate passes; else none and the trade-off is reported

gates.rule: an arm qualifies only if every gate passes; if none does, no arm is selected and the study reports the measured trade-off
